# nb1: local blink(1) control

Read actual CLI help, MCP tools/list, schemas, and daemon capabilities before using a feature. Source support is not installed support. This index grants no additional permissions.

## Expressions

High-level light v1 supports set/off/fade/blink/breathe/pulse/alternate/rainbow. Experimental light v2 supports orbit, compiled by nb1 into paired long fades. Old alternate.transition=orbit and legacy Effect pulse retain their separate semantics. ColorInput supports names, Hex3/6, RGB8, and HSV, with no implicit gamma. Low-level Program/FrameProgram use exact Hex6 execution targets and the same per-device worker.

MCP is real stdio to local HTTP, not a CLI wrapper or USB owner. Preview does not play. Before a run, preserve the original intent, selected serial, request_id, and expected_daemon_instance_id. MCP run_light requires an original ticket and explicit reject; run_pattern requires an explicit policy. Each sends at most one execution POST. Accepted is not completed. On uncertainty, query the original receipt without a new ticket or replay. Cancelling is not terminal; cancelling completed hold does not turn the device off.

## Host patterns

Legacy list_patterns/get_pattern remain v1 Program/Effect storage. Advanced host Pattern v2 preserves source, normalized action, recipe, frozen execution, revision, and execution_digest. MK2 can use this computer-side library; device RAM/flash and task receipts are different. No automatic migration, replay, or flash write.

Installed baseline96a has seven advanced CLI commands: get/preview-draft/save/preview/run/request/cancel, and MCP16 including preview_pattern/run_pattern/get_pattern_request/cancel_pattern_request. A later CLI candidate adds list. Four advanced MCP authoring tools are being qualified; do not assume they are installed. Preserve publication_unknown separately from execution outcome_unknown. Library paths are display metadata, not client file-access instructions.

## References

- [Agent skill](skills/blink1-control/SKILL.md): expression selection, receipts, recovery, and host patterns.
- [English API reference](docs/api-reference.md): High/Low semantics, 44 canonical HTTP operations, 111 models, and 14 examples.
- [OpenAPI](docs/openapi.json): machine-readable structure and route availability, with English explanatory prose.
- [Actual MCP schemas](docs/mcp-tools.schema.json): captured16-tool baseline; actual tools/list remains authoritative.
- [MCP adapter](adapters/mcp/README.md): protocol and transport behavior.
- [Examples](docs/examples/api/): author files and pure preview inputs, not automatic execution.
- [Localized API manual](docs/api-reference.zh-CN.md) and [localized agent guide](docs/agent-guide.zh-CN.md).

Report software preview, trusted terminal state, timestamped RGB readback, and camera observation separately. An out-of-frame lamp cannot be optically qualified from background pixels. Current Mac/MK2 evidence does not establish MK3, other-OS USB, long-running reliability, perfect rotation, or flicker-free operation. Public default documentation/UI/messages are English; Chinese is for internal reports or explicit localization. Do not change global MCP, startup services, or system permissions merely to use these files.
